paper_verdict.estimator_family: OLS (pooled translog regression, no fixed effects, intercept suppressed)
paper_verdict.pooling_concerns: Outcome is log GDP in current US$ levels (not growth, per capita or PPP). Exposure is telecom investment (% of GDP) in a translog with squared and interaction terms, so the linear and interaction coefficients are not elasticities and are not comparable to standard estimates. Only p-values are printed, no SEs. Table 1 prints no minus signs (text says the Followers interaction is negative). Leaders rows repeat the complete-set coefficients 42.8020 and 57.4954, probably a table error. Leaders and Followers splits come from earlier DEA/cluster work. Not suitable for pooling with elasticity or growth estimates.

Table 1, Leaders, p. 477. Matches; positive per text p. 476 ('complementarity is positive for the Leaders'). Identical to the complete-set interaction coefficient, a likely table error.
